name: OGT Certification
note: Each OGT Certification carries exactly one trait, a unique Certification Pass Number, so every value appears once and no rarity ordering exists. Rarity, completion, duplicate and trait-safety views are switched off deliberately: running them would manufacture rankings with no meaning. Market and holder views stay on because those are real. On-chain supply is 1000 (ids 1-1000, none burned); 901 are indexed with metadata.
